name: Does my homeowner's insurance cover leak damage repair?

mainEntity.name: Does my homeowner's insurance cover leak damage repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Many homeowner's insurance policies cover sudden and accidental water damage, but typically not damage from long-term leaks or neglect. It's essential to review your specific policy details to understand coverage limits and exclusions. Documenting the damage and the source of the leak thoroughly can assist with your claim. Maine Results, Inc. can provide detailed reports for insurance purposes.
acceptedAnswer.description: Homeowner's insurance often covers sudden leak damage, but not long-term issues. Check your policy and document everything for claims.
